t: This is the Buddhist Society, a UK registered charity that encourages the study and practice of Buddhist principles. It was founded by Christmas Humphreys, who started what became the London Buddhist Society in 1924. Humphreys was a barrister who prosecuted several controversial cases and later became a judge at the Old Bailey. In his day he was the best-known British convert to Buddhism. He wrote on Mahayana Buddhism, and the society he founded had a seminal influence on the growth of Buddhism in Britain.
